description: Making AI Work: The platform simplifies access to government services, allowing residents to request certificates, track grievances, and interact via WhatsApp.
body_lead: Meta ties up with Odisha govt to launch WhatsApp chatbot ‘Ama Sathi’ for 120 citizen services The platform simplifies access to government services, allowing residents to request certificates, track grievances, and interact via WhatsApp. The Odisha government, in partnership with Meta, has launched a WhatsApp-based chatbot named Ama Sath, providing access to 120 government services for over 45 million residents of the state, as reported by ANI. The launch took place in the presence of Chief Secretary Manoj Ahuja.
